info.name: Qabz
info.description: HTTP API of the Qabz service (grpc-gateway). Kept up to date with every API change: docs/standards/PROJECT_SPECIFIC_CONVENTIONS.md section 7. The request IDs of each bill type are collection variables (<billType>_billId, <billType>_payId, gas_participateCode, irancell_mobile_phone): set them in the collection Variables tab (or an environment of the same names) and every request body uses them. A collection pre-request script adds the headers of the web client (Accept, Accept-Language fa-IR, the Grpc-metadata-* device headers, Origin and Referer of the stage PWA, User-Agent, client, sec-ch-ua*, Host stage-api.780.ir, ...) to every request; a header that a request sets itself wins.

variable.description: Water/Inquiry body billId (a valid bill ID); also MyBills/Insert billId
Water/Inquiry body payId (bill ignores it for water)
Electricity/Inquiry body billId (a valid bill ID)

Electricity/Inquiry body payId (bill ignores it for electricity); Electricity/Order body payId (task 052: a valid pay ID of 18 000 000 rials, so the order takes the raw inquiry; empty: the price comes from the Tavanir inquiry)
Gas/Inquiry body billId; with gas_payId also set, the request is the raw inquiry (no provider)
Gas/Inquiry body payId; with gas_billId also set, the request is the raw inquiry (no provider)
Gas/Inquiry body participateCode (the inquiry ID of a gas bill)
Gas/Order body billId (task 053: a valid gas bill ID, type digit 3)
Gas/Order body payId (task 053: a valid pay ID of 18 000 000 rials, so the order takes the raw inquiry; empty: the price comes from the gas inquiry provider with the participate code)
Phone/Inquiry body billId (optional; a valid bill ID when set)
Phone/Inquiry body payId (not checked)
Phone/Inquiry body phone (a mobile number in the 98 form; the inquiry ID)
Phone/Inquiry MCI body billId (optional; a valid bill ID when set)
Phone/Inquiry MCI body payId (not checked)
Phone/Inquiry MCI body phone (a mobile number in the 98 form; the inquiry ID)
Phone/Inquiry Rightel body billId (optional; a valid bill ID when set)
Phone/Inquiry Rightel body payId (not checked)
Phone/Inquiry Rightel body phone (a mobile number in the 98 form; the inquiry ID)
Tel/Inquiry body phone (a landline number; 98 form, 0 form or ten digits; the inquiry ID)
Tel/Inquiry body billId (optional; a valid bill ID when set; with payId: the raw inquiry)
Tel/Inquiry body payId (optional; with billId: the raw inquiry)

request.description: haf80.api.bill.Service/Greeting. Pings the service. Needs Authorization: Bearer {{token}} (collection auth), unless debug.auth.disable is true. Expected: HTTP 200 and {"message":"Hello"}; without a valid token HTTP 403.

header.description: Language of the list (raw value, as bill). Without the header: fa-IR.

request.description: haf80.api.bill.Service/Get. Returns the service list (bill types) of the Accept-Language language from the services table, by order, cached in memory for 60s. Needs Authorization: Bearer {{token}} (collection auth), unless debug.auth.disable is true. Expected: HTTP 200 and {"serviceId":<service.id>,"services":[{"name","isActive","tag","type","inquiry","icon"}]}; inquiry is the stored value (bill always sends true). Without a valid token HTTP 403; a database error HTTP 500.

exec: pm.test("has serviceId and a services list", function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("serviceId"); pm.expect(b.services).to.be.an("array"); });

request.description: haf80.api.bill.MyBills/GetAll. Returns the saved bills (My Bills) of the user of the JWT from the bills table: enabled rows only, newest first, with the bill mapping: tel/mobile give billId and phone = the stored phone (a second bill with the same phone is left out); gas gives billId and participateCode; operator and isPined come from json_data. Needs Authorization: Bearer {{token}} (collection auth), unless debug.auth.disable is true (then the user is debug.auth.mock_user_id; with that key empty HTTP 403). Expected: HTTP 200 and {"serviceId":<service.id>,"data":[{"id","name","type","lastOrderDate","billId","operator","isPined","phone","participateCode"}]}; a user with no bills gets "data":[]. Without a valid token HTTP 403; a database error HTTP 500.

exec: pm.test("has serviceId and a data list", function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("serviceId"); pm.expect(b.data).to.be.an("array"); });

request.description: haf80.api.bill.MyBills/Insert. Saves a bill (My Bills) for the user of the JWT in the bills table, with the bill rules: type gas, water, tel, mobile or electricity; water/electricity need a valid bill ID (check digit); gas needs a participateCode or a valid billId; mobile/tel need a phone (or the phone in billId), normalized to 98... (task 038: a mobile phone is valid in every common form: 0 form, ten digits, +98, 0098, spaces, dashes, brackets, Persian or Arabic digits; tel is not changed) An empty name gets the default name; mobile with no operator is saved as mci. A bill the user already has (same billId or inquiry ID) is not saved again: the answer has the existing id. Needs Authorization: Bearer {{token}} (collection auth), unless debug.auth.disable is true (then the user is debug.auth.mock_user_id; with that key empty HTTP 403). Expected: HTTP 200 and {"id","name","type","billId","operator","phone",...} echoing the request. An invalid request HTTP 400 "invalid parameter"; without a valid token HTTP 403; a database error HTTP 500.

variable.description: The id of a saved bill (the id that Insert or GetAll returns).

request.description: haf80.api.bill.MyBills/Delete. Deletes a saved bill (My Bills) of the user of the JWT, as bill does: the row stays with status disable, so GetAll no longer lists it. The id is checked with uuid.Parse of github.com/google/uuid (upper case, {...}, 32 hex digits and urn:uuid: are accepted) and goes to the database as sent. An unknown id, a bill of another user and a bill that is already disabled change nothing and still succeed. Needs Authorization: Bearer {{token}} (collection auth), unless debug.auth.disable is true (then the user is debug.auth.mock_user_id). Expected: HTTP 200 and {"message":"عملیات با موفقیت انجام شد"} (the operation was done successfully; bill sends its internal-error text on success, docs/this_vs_bill.md item 12). An id that does not parse, an empty id, a call with no user (debug.auth.disable with an empty mock_user_id) or a database error (also urn:uuid:..., which Postgres rejects): HTTP 500 {"code":2,"message":"خطای داخلی رخ داده است"} (gRPC Unknown, as bill). Without a valid token HTTP 403.

exec: pm.test("has the success message", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("عملیات با موفقیت انجام شد"); });

request.description: haf80.api.bill.Water/Inquiry. Inquires a water bill by billId (payId and participateCode are ignored, as in bill). The provider of (water, inquiry) is picked with ProvidersService; the saved inquiries of the same bill and provider that are younger than caching.water (default 1h; any user's rows count) answer with NO provider call, else the provider is called (Qabzino) and the answer is saved. With debug.mocks.qabzino.enable true (dev mode only) the Qabzino adapter answers a fixed answer: price 25000000, payId 2500012345, paymentDeadline 2030-01-01 (return_type success), or the provider-down error (return_type error). Needs Authorization: Bearer {{token}} (collection auth), unless debug.auth.disable is true (then the user is debug.auth.mock_user_id; with that key empty HTTP 403). Expected: HTTP 200 and {"price":<rials>,"paymentDeadline":"yyyy-mm-dd","payId":"...","billId":"..."} (a paid bill: price 0 and an empty payId). An invalid billId (6 to 13 digits with a valid check digit) HTTP 400 ("invalid parameter"); no valid token HTTP 403; no enabled provider, a failed provider call or a provider with no adapter HTTP 503 (message: the provider inquiry is temporarily disabled); a provider that has no inquiry for the bill HTTP 400 with the provider message; any other failure HTTP 500.

exec: pm.test("has price, payId, billId and paymentDeadline", function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("price"); pm.expect(b.price).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("payId"); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("billId"); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("paymentDeadline"); });

request.description: haf80.api.bill.Water/NewOrder (task 048: the water bill, paid through Parsian). Saves an order of a water bill and answers the signed order token. The request and the answer are those of bill (NewOrderBillPayRequest, NewOrderResponse), unchanged; price and paymentType are not read. The steps are those of bill: (1) the request needs billId or payId; else HTTP 400 (no log line). (2) the inquiry ID is participateCode when it is set, else billId. (3) the order provider of (water, order) is picked with ProvidersService: Parsian (dev seed row 45, enabled). (4) bill already paid: a pending or success order of the billId and payId of the request in providers.internal.parsian.settlement_inquiry_water (default 360h): HTTP 400 with bill's text. (5) the price: a numeric billId and payId give the raw inquiry (the amount of the pay ID, no provider call); else the regular inquiry of water (saved inquiries for caching.paid_water, default 72h). (6) no provider fee; the fee (fees table; no row: 9000). (7) one orders row with the status initial. (8) the token (RS256): payload serviceId, orderId, provider, price, userId and data (payId, type, billId, payAmount, rawAmount, about, aboutIcon, invoicePayID, invoiceBillID, receiptPayID, receiptBillID; feeAmount and feeDescription when the fee is above 0). Expected with the dev seed and the default variables (water_payId 2500012310: 25 000 000 rials): HTTP 200, price 25009000. A second order of a paid bill: HTTP 400. Needs a user (a token, or debug.auth.disable with debug.auth.mock_user_id): no user is HTTP 403. No enabled order provider: HTTP 503. The payment step (PaymentComplete/OrderComplete) is gRPC only, on the internal server server.internal_grpc.addr; it has no HTTP route. After a 200 answer, the test script saves orderId and price in order_token and order_price, for Payment (external) / Invoice.

exec: pm.test('answer has serviceId, orderId and price', function () {
// Saves the order token and the total of the answer for Payment (external) / Invoice.

request.description: haf80.api.bill.Electricity/Inquiry. Inquires an electricity bill by billId (payId and participateCode are ignored, as in bill), with its details. The provider of (electricity, inquiry) is picked with ProvidersService; the saved inquiries of the same bill and provider that are younger than caching.electricity (default 1h; any user's rows count) answer with NO provider call and with the SAME details (saved in bill_inquiries.extra_data), else the provider is called (Tavanir) and the answer is saved. With debug.mocks.tavanir.enable true (dev mode only) the Tavanir adapter answers a fixed answer: price 18000000, payId 1800012345, paymentDeadline 2030-01-01, phase "تک فاز", companyName "توزیع برق تهران بزرگ", tariffType "خانگی", customerType "1", serialNumber 12345678, serviceAddress "تهران، خیابان آزادی، پلاک ۱", servicePostCode 1234567890, customerName "مشترک آزمایشی" (return_type success), or the provider-down error (return_type error). Needs Authorization: Bearer {{token}} (collection auth), unless debug.auth.disable is true (then the user is debug.auth.mock_user_id; with that key empty HTTP 403). Expected: HTTP 200 and {"payId":"...","billId":"...","price":<rials>,"paymentDeadline":"yyyy-mm-dd","phase":"...","companyName":"...","tariffType":"...","customerType":"<number as text>","serialNumber":"...","serviceAddress":"...","servicePostCode":"...","customerName":"..."} (a paid bill: price 0, an empty payId and empty details; an answer with no details: empty detail fields). An invalid billId (6 to 13 digits with a valid check digit) HTTP 400 ("invalid parameter"); no valid token HTTP 403; no enabled provider, a failed provider call or a provider with no adapter HTTP 503 (message: the provider inquiry is temporarily disabled); a provider that has no inquiry for the bill HTTP 400 with the provider message; any other failure HTTP 500. POST /v1/electricity/inquiry/document (InquiryDocument) is not implemented yet (HTTP 501).

exec: pm.test("has price, payId, billId and paymentDeadline", function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("price"); pm.expect(b.price).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("payId"); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("billId"); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("paymentDeadline"); });

pm.test("has the details", function () { const b = pm.response.json(); ["phase", "companyName", "tariffType", "customerType", "serialNumber", "serviceAddress", "servicePostCode", "customerName"].forEach(function (k) { pm.expect(b).to.have.property(k); pm.expect(b[k]).to.be.a("string"); }); });

The request and the answer are those of bill (NewOrderBillPayRequest, NewOrderResponse), unchanged; price and paymentType are not read. The steps are those of bill and of Water / Order: (1) the request needs billId or payId; else HTTP 400 (no log line). (2) the inquiry ID is participateCode when it is set, else billId. (3) the order provider of (electricity, order) is picked with ProvidersService: Parsian (dev seed row 47, enabled; the eways2 row 17 is disabled and has no adapter in Qabz). (6) no provider fee; the fee (fees table; no row: 9000). (7) one orders row with the status initial. request.description: haf80.api.bill.Gas/Inquiry (task 023). Inquires a gas bill by participateCode (the gas subscription code). The request and the answer are those of bill (InquiryBillPayRequest, InquiryBillPayResponse), unchanged. Request rules, as in bill: participateCode or billId is required, and participateCode or payId is required; a billId that is sent must be a valid bill ID (6 to 13 digits with a valid check digit). So a request with only billId is invalid. A request with both billId and payId is the raw inquiry of bill: no provider, no saved inquiry; the price is read from the pay ID (the digits before the last 5, in thousands of rials) and the answer is HTTP 200 {"price":<rials>,"payId":"...","billId":"..."} with paymentDeadline empty; a billId that is not valid, a payId that is not valid or a billId of an unknown bill type is HTTP 400 with the text of bill (شناسه قبض نامعتبر است, شناسه پرداخت نامعتبر است, نوع قبض نامعتبر است). The inquiry ID is the participateCode: it is the cache key and what the provider gets (two participate codes are two cache keys). The provider of (gas, inquiry) is picked with ProvidersService; the saved inquiries of the same participateCode and provider that are younger than caching.gas (default 1h; any user's rows count) answer with NO provider call, else the provider is called (Qabzino: Ayantech GasBillInquiry at providers.external.qabzino.gas_bill_endpoint) and the answer is saved. In the dev seed the enabled gas provider is parsian (no adapter yet: HTTP 503); to use Qabzino enable providers row 35 and disable row 43. With debug.mocks.qabzino.enable true (dev mode only, providers.external.qabzino.enabled true) the Qabzino adapter answers a fixed answer: price 32000000, payId 3200012345, paymentDeadline 2030-01-01, billId 1234567890125 (return_type success), or the provider-down error (return_type error). Needs Authorization: Bearer {{token}} (collection auth), unless debug.auth.disable is true (then the user is debug.auth.mock_user_id; with that key empty HTTP 403). Expected: HTTP 200 and {"price":<rials>,"paymentDeadline":"yyyy-mm-dd","payId":"...","billId":"<the bill ID of the provider>"} (no bill to pay: price 0 and an empty payId). An invalid request HTTP 400 ("invalid parameter"); no valid token HTTP 403; no enabled provider, a failed provider call or a provider with no adapter HTTP 503 (message: the provider inquiry is temporarily disabled); a provider that has no inquiry for the code HTTP 400 with the provider message; any other failure HTTP 500. POST /v1/gas/order is Gas / Order (task 053); POST /v1/gas/complete-order is not implemented yet (HTTP 501).

exec: pm.test("has price, payId, billId and paymentDeadline", function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("price"); pm.expect(b.price).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("payId"); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("billId"); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("paymentDeadline"); });

request.description: haf80.api.bill.Gas/NewOrder (task 053: the gas bill, paid through Parsian only). Saves an order of a gas bill and answers the signed order token. The request and the answer are those of bill (NewOrderBillPayRequest, NewOrderResponse; bill's Gas.NewOrderV2), unchanged; price and paymentType are not read. The steps are those of Water / Order and Electricity / Order: (1) the request needs billId or payId (bill's order check, not the check of Gas / Inquiry: a request with only billId is an order); else HTTP 400 (no log line). (2) the inquiry ID is participateCode when it is set, else billId (it is orders.data and the inquiry_id of the Parsian payment). (3) the order provider of (gas, order) is picked with ProvidersService: Parsian (dev seed row 46, enabled; the eways2 row 18 is disabled and has no adapter in Qabz). (4) bill already paid: a pending or success order of the billId and payId of the request in providers.internal.parsian.settlement_inquiry_gas (default 360h): HTTP 400 with bill's text. (5) the price: a numeric billId and payId give the raw inquiry (the amount of the pay ID, no provider call); else the regular inquiry of gas with the inquiry ID (the enabled gas inquiry provider; saved inquiries for caching.paid_gas, default 72h). In the dev seed that provider is parsian (row 43), which has no gas inquiry: HTTP 503; with Qabzino (row 35 enabled, row 43 disabled) and debug.mocks.qabzino.enabled: price 32009000 from the mock. (6) no provider fee; the fee (fees table; no row: 9000). (7) one orders row with the status initial. (8) the token (RS256): payload serviceId, orderId, provider, price, userId and data (payId, type gas, billId, payAmount, rawAmount, about (bill's text قبض گاز), aboutIcon (Gas.svg), invoicePayID, invoiceBillID, receiptPayID, receiptBillID; feeAmount and feeDescription when the fee is above 0). Expected with the default variables (gas_order_billId 1234567890133, gas_order_payId 1800000030: 18 000 000 rials): HTTP 200, price 18009000. A second order of a paid bill: HTTP 400. Needs a user (a token, or debug.auth.disable with debug.auth.mock_user_id): no user is HTTP 403. No enabled order provider: HTTP 503. The payment step (PaymentComplete/OrderComplete) is gRPC only, on the internal server server.internal_grpc.addr; it has no HTTP route. After a 200 answer, the test script saves orderId and price in order_token and order_price, for Payment (external) / Invoice.

request.description: haf80.api.bill.Phone/Inquiry (task 035: the Irancell operator). Inquires a mobile bill by phone. The request and the answer are those of bill (InquiryPhoneRequest, InquiryPhoneResponse), unchanged. Request rules, as in bill: phone is required and is a mobile number; since task 038 it is converted to the 98 form (989 and nine digits) before the check, so the 98 form, 0935..., 935..., +98935..., 0098935..., spaces, dashes, brackets and Persian or Arabic digits are all valid and are one cache key (a landline, another length or a letter is invalid: HTTP 400); a billId that is sent must be a valid bill ID; operator and service must be values of the enum (mci, irancell, rightel, unknown); payId is not checked. Only operator is read (service is never used, as in bill), and a request with no operator is mci. Operators: irancell, mci (task 036, the item Inquiry MCI) and rightel (task 037, the item Inquiry Rightel) are answered; unknown is HTTP 400. Note: the gateway reads an operator name that is not in the enum as mci. The inquiry ID is the phone: it is the cache key and what the provider gets. Irancell: the provider of (irancell, inquiry) is picked with ProvidersService and ONLY the Irancell provider (providers row 38, enabled in the dev seed) may answer: when the pick is another provider, nobody is called and the answer is HTTP 503. The Irancell adapter calls the irancell service (our own service, gRPC pb.InternalService/BillInquiry at providers.internal.irancell.grpc_address); providers.internal.irancell.enabled false fails every call as provider down. caching.irancell is 0 by default (no cache, as bill): every request asks Irancell; with a TTL, the saved inquiries of the same phone younger than the TTL answer with no provider call. With debug.mocks.irancell.enable true (dev mode only, providers.internal.irancell.enabled true) the adapter answers a fixed answer: midTerm price 150000, fullTerm price 450000, no billId, no payId, no paymentDeadline (return_type success), or the provider-down error (return_type error). Needs Authorization: Bearer {{token}} (collection auth), unless debug.auth.disable is true (then the user is debug.auth.mock_user_id; with that key empty HTTP 403). Expected: HTTP 200 and {"midTerm":{"billId":"","payId":"","price":<rials>,"paymentDeadline":"","providerId":0},"fullTerm":{...}} (Irancell gives no billId, payId or paymentDeadline; providerId is always 0, as in bill; no debt: price 0 in both). An invalid request HTTP 400 ("invalid parameter"); no valid token HTTP 403; no enabled provider, a provider other than Irancell, a failed provider call or a provider with no adapter HTTP 503 (message: the provider inquiry is temporarily disabled); a provider that has no inquiry for the phone HTTP 400 with the provider message; any other failure HTTP 500. POST /v1/mobile/complete-order is not implemented yet (HTTP 501).

exec: pm.test("has midTerm and fullTerm with a price", function () { const b = pm.response.json(); ["midTerm", "fullTerm"].forEach(function (k) { pm.expect(b).to.have.property(k); pm.expect(b[k].price).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(b[k]).to.have.property("billId"); pm.expect(b[k]).to.have.property("payId"); pm.expect(b[k]).to.have.property("paymentDeadline"); }); });

request.description: haf80.api.bill.Phone/Inquiry (task 036: the MCI operator). The same endpoint, request rules and answer as the item Inquiry (Irancell); operator mci, or no operator. The bill type is mobile and the inquiry ID is the phone (the cache key). The provider is the first enabled row of (mobile, inquiry) in the sorted provider list (ProvidersService, priority ascending): Jiring Switch (providers row 28; the jiring-switch service, providers.internal.jiring_switch.*) and Parsian (row 39; the parsian-v2 service, providers.internal.parsian.*). The wanted order is Jiring Switch first, Parsian next, set only with the row priority; in the dev seed row 28 is disabled with priority 10, so Parsian answers until row 28 is enabled with priority 1. One request calls one provider: its answer is the answer, also an error (HTTP 503); the request never calls the other provider. A switch to the next provider is the job of the Provider Switcher, only when the circuit breaker of the provider opens (not built yet). caching.mobile is 5h by default: saved inquiries of the same phone (and the same provider) younger than the TTL answer with no provider call; two saved rows of the same inquiry type do not answer (as bill). Mocks (dev mode only, with the provider enabled): debug.mocks.jiring_switch answers billId 9120000036, midTerm payId 21003611 price 210000, fullTerm payId 61003622 price 610000, no paymentDeadline; debug.mocks.parsian answers billId 9120000039, midTerm payId 22003911 price 220000, fullTerm payId 62003922 price 620000, paymentDeadline 2026-12-20; return_type error gives the provider-down error. Needs Authorization: Bearer {{token}} (collection auth), unless debug.auth.disable is true. Expected: HTTP 200 and {"midTerm":{"billId":...,"payId":...,"price":<rials>,"paymentDeadline":...,"providerId":0},"fullTerm":{...}} (no debt: price 0 in both). An invalid request HTTP 400; no valid token HTTP 403; no enabled provider, a failed provider call or a provider with no adapter HTTP 503; a provider that has no inquiry for the phone HTTP 400 with the provider message; any other failure HTTP 500.

exec: pm.test("has midTerm and fullTerm with a price", function () { const b = pm.response.json(); ["midTerm", "fullTerm"].forEach(function (k) { pm.expect(b).to.have.property(k); pm.expect(b[k].price).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(b[k]).to.have.property("billId"); pm.expect(b[k]).to.have.property("payId"); pm.expect(b[k]).to.have.property("paymentDeadline"); }); });

request.description: haf80.api.bill.Phone/Inquiry (task 037: the Rightel operator). The same endpoint, request rules and answer as the item Inquiry (Irancell); operator rightel. The bill type is mobilemidtermRightel and the inquiry ID is the phone (the cache key). ONLY the Qabzino provider may answer (operator rule): the provider of (mobilemidtermRightel, inquiry) is picked with ProvidersService (providers row 34, enabled in the dev seed); when the pick is another provider, or no row is enabled, nobody is called and the answer is HTTP 503 (no fallback). The Qabzino adapter calls Ayantech RightelMobileBillInquiry at providers.external.qabzino.rightel_bill_endpoint with the phone in the 0 form (0 and the ten digits); every call is charged. providers.external.qabzino.enabled false fails every call as provider down. Ayantech codes: G00000 success (billId of the mid-term part, a pay ID and a price for each part, no paymentDeadline); GD2268 no debt (price 0 in both); GD2261 and GD2267 HTTP 400 with the user text; GD2266 and every other code HTTP 503. caching.mobile is 5h by default (the key of MCI, as bill): saved inquiries of the same phone (and provider) younger than the TTL answer with no provider call. With debug.mocks.qabzino.enable true (dev mode only, providers.external.qabzino.enabled true) the adapter answers a fixed answer: billId 9200000034, midTerm payId 23000341 price 230000, fullTerm payId 63000342 price 630000, no paymentDeadline (return_type success), or the provider-down error (return_type error). Needs Authorization: Bearer {{token}} (collection auth), unless debug.auth.disable is true. Expected: HTTP 200 and {"midTerm":{"billId":...,"payId":...,"price":<rials>,"paymentDeadline":"","providerId":0},"fullTerm":{...}}. request.description: haf80.api.bill.Tel/Inquiry (task 025). Inquires a landline (telephone) bill by phone. The request and the answer are those of bill (InquiryTelRequest, InquiryPhoneResponse), unchanged. Request rules, as in bill: phone or billId is required, and phone or payId is required; a billId that is sent must be a valid bill ID. So a request with only billId or only payId is invalid. A request with both billId and payId is the raw inquiry of bill (with or without a phone): no provider, no saved inquiry; the price is read from the pay ID; the answer has only fullTerm (billId, payId, price, no paymentDeadline) and an empty midTerm; a bad pay ID or a bill ID of an unknown type is HTTP 400 with bill's text. Else the phone is converted to the 98 form with bill's rule (982188776655, 02188776655 and 2188776655 are one number) and must then be 98 and ten digits (else HTTP 400; bill sends any phone to the provider). The 98 form is the inquiry ID: the cache key and what the provider gets. ONLY Karashop answers (operator decision of 2026-11-14): the provider of (tel, inquiry) is picked with ProvidersService (the dev seed has Karashop row 124325 enabled); when the pick is another provider (Parsian 40, Qabzino 52), nobody is called and the answer is HTTP 503. The Karashop adapter sends two calls to the Karashop API at the same time (tci-end-getBillAccInfo for the full term, tci-mid-getBillAccInfo for the mid term) and writes one request row; providers.external.karashop.enabled false fails every call as provider down. caching.tel (default 1h): saved inquiries of the same number younger than the TTL answer with no provider call; two saved rows of the same inquiry type do not answer (as bill). With debug.mocks.karashop.enable true (dev mode only, providers.external.karashop.enabled true) the adapter answers a fixed answer: billId 2101234560040, midTerm payId 12000035 price 120000, fullTerm payId 35000042 price 350000, no paymentDeadline (return_type success), or the provider-down error (return_type error). Needs Authorization: Bearer {{token}} (collection auth), unless debug.auth.disable is true (then the user is debug.auth.mock_user_id; with that key empty HTTP 403). Expected: HTTP 200 and {"midTerm":{"billId":...,"payId":...,"price":<rials>,"paymentDeadline":"","providerId":0},"fullTerm":{...}} (each part has the bill ID of its own Karashop call; providerId is always 0, as in bill; no debt: price 0). An invalid request HTTP 400 ("invalid parameter"); no valid token HTTP 403; no enabled provider, a provider other than Karashop or a failed Karashop call (either of the two) HTTP 503 (message: the provider inquiry is temporarily disabled); Karashop refuses the number (telStatus 2, status 400 or 404) HTTP 400 with bill's text; any other failure HTTP 500. POST /v1/tel/complete-order is not implemented yet (HTTP 501).

Run Phone / Order first: its test script sets order_token (the JWT of orderId) and order_price (the total), and this body sends them. serviceId is 149, fixed in the body (operator request); it is not the serviceId of the Order V2 answer. The payment service checks the token with the public key of the general private key (providers.internal.payment_server.private_key_path), so the Qabz App must sign with that key. The URL is {{BASE_URL}}/payment/v2/product/invoice (operator: one BASE_URL for every request); set BASE_URL to the host of the payment service (for example https://stage-api.780.ir) before this request. The request uses the collection auth (Bearer {{token}}); change it here if the payment service needs another one.
